Rule (STAMP ROTATED+FLIPPED TEMPLATE IN MAROON ALONG 7→8 VECTOR): READ rotation control (determines k = 0/1/2 CW rotations or D4 code). READ optional FLIP-6 (toggle horizontal flip). STAMP the transformed template in COLOR-9 (maroon) at the 7-marker position, then at successive offsets (+delta) until off-grid. Net: blue template + rotation control → maroon stamps repeated along the 7→8 vector path.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered normalized list of relative cells in the input-dependent transformed template.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Read the blue template and bottom controls, then derive the normalized rotated and optionally reflected template footprint.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Stamp that footprint at every in-bounds anchor along the 7-to-8 vector and along its inverse, painting the resulting bidirectional path maroon.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Every path anchor paints the footprint produced by Step A; replacing it with the raw template changes the stamped geometry and therefore the final grid.
